title: Failure Intelligence & Locator Self-Healing
subtitle: Analyze UI, API and Python failures with traceable evidence, decisions, repair advice and actual verification results.
noProject: Please select or create a project first.
emptyBody: All tests are passing or failures have been healed.
assertionRepairNotApplicable: This is an assertion failure (ASSERTION_FAILURE), so locator repair does not apply. Check the actual value, expected value and test intent; do not change the assertion merely to make the test pass.
missingFailedLocator: No actual failed locator was recorded. Check the original error and page evidence before requesting locator repair.
locatorRepairNotApplicable: The failure is classified as {{classification}}; locator repair does not apply. Diagnose the cause based on the error type first.
noAlternativeLocator: No valid candidate differs from the original locator; no unchanged patch is generated.
openInStudioTitle: Open the failing test file in the Automation Studio
debugFromFailureTitle: Open the failure in Studio and pause on its failure breakpoint
fallbackDiagnosis: The AI provider is unavailable. This preliminary result was generated by local rules.
repairNotVerified: Playwright did not verify a replacement locator. Review the evidence and edit the code manually before applying a fix.
recurrenceEmpty: No prior similar occurrences recorded in history for this failure signature.
selectPrompt: Select a test failure to perform AI root-cause diagnosis or generate locator repair proposals.
jiraSynthesizing: Synthesizing bug details, stack trace, and reproduction steps from failure artifacts...
diagnosisStreamIncomplete: The analysis connection ended without a complete diagnosis. Please retry.
alertRepairLocatorNotFound: The locator {{locator}} was not found in {{file}} — the file may have changed since the failure was recorded.
noDiffAvailable: No diff generated for this proposal.
simulatedDiagnosis: This is a simulated demonstration, not a verified AI diagnosis or repair result.

workflow.title: Failure analysis workflow
workflow.interruptedDetail: A service restart interrupted this analysis. Evidence is retained; unfinished steps are not successful.
workflow.verificationBoundary: Advice is not verification. Code changes require approval; only an actual passing rerun verifies a repair.
workflow.audit: View full execution record (events, sources and timestamps)
workflow.verificationFailed: Retest did not pass · repair remains unverified
